details:
- CVE-2024-12718: extractall: re-apply the filter at directory-attribute
  fixup, skip fixup if the entry is no longer a directory
- CVE-2025-4138: data_filter: strip .. components from symlink targets in
  data_filter to prevent traversal via symlinks in the link target
- CVE-2025-4330: re-apply filter when a hard/symlink extraction falls back
  to copying another archive member
- CVE-2025-4435: extract/extractall: don't extract rejected members when
  errorlevel=0
- CVE-2025-4517: raise exceptions on OS errors in realpath to prevent
  overly-long symlink chains from evading destination bounds checking
